messages:
carmen: Heads-up — CI is failing in master for audit-event-validator after the KMS schema tweak. Failing tests: audit_validator::golden_matches and audit_schema::compat_checks. CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/12345 :frowning:

 audit-bot: Build #12345 failed: audit-validator (linux-x64)
---
Error: ValidationError: missing required field 'actor.principal_id' in event 'KmsKeyAccessed'
---

 rohit: Reproduced locally by running:
```
make test-audit && pytest tests/audit/test_validator.py::test_golden_fixtures -q
```
Failing diff looks like:
```
- "actor": { "id": "u-123" }
+ "actor": { "principal_id": "u-123" }
```
I think the schema change in kms-events introduced principal_id instead of id. Validator expects id.

 sam: Looks like we merged the KMS schema PR that renamed actor.id -> actor.principal_id without adding a compatibility mapping. Validator v2 validates strictly.
Workarounds:
- pin validator to v1 in CI (temporary)
- add compatibility shim in validator to accept either id or principal_id

 elaine: We should avoid pinning CI long-term. Proposal: add a small schema migration step in audit_parser that normalizes incoming events to canonical fields before validation. Also update golden fixtures to include both variants in a compatibility test.

 rohit: I can push a quick validator patch to accept principal_id if id missing. Will add unit test and update golden fixture for KmsKeyAccessed. If anyone objects, say now.

 carmen: +1 to the shim approach. Owner rohit to do quick fix + tests. If patch lands, we should retrigger CI and then schedule a follow-up to add a migration/normalizer.

 sam: I'll open the CI rollback PR to pin validator to v1 as a safety net; will mark it revertable and set it to auto-merge off. Link: https://git.redwood.example/repo/PR/678

 elaine: Also note: customer-facing audit exporters may rely on the new field name. Need to coordinate with product before we change exported schema. Create a small RFC and cross-org heads-up.

 carmen: Good call. rohit, can you add a short note in the PR describing the user-visible change and the plan for soft migration? We'll also add an integration check in nightly to run both old and new fixtures.

 rohit: Yep — pushing branch now. Expect PR in ~1h. I'll include test names and a golden fixture diff.

 audit-bot: PR opened: repo/PR/679 by rohit — "validator: accept actor.principal_id as fallback". CI will run.

 carmen: Thanks everyone. Triage complete — owner: rohit, mitigation: pin validator if needed (sam), follow-up: migration RFC (elaine).
